svg.title: Response order after installing tensorlake 0.5.144
svg.desc: Five steps in order. One: find installs of tensorlake 0.5.144 in lockfiles and CI logs. Two: on each hit, remove the gh-token-monitor service and its files. Three: only then revoke and rotate GitHub, npm, cloud, SSH, Kubernetes, Vault and AI tool credentials from a clean machine. Four: audit repos and packages the tokens could write to for planted .claude and .vscode files, commits authored by claude, the dependabot setup-formatter branch, and unexpected npm releases. Five: rebuild any machine that cannot be proven clean. Revoking the GitHub token before step two triggers the monitor, which deletes the home directory.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, sans-serif

systemd user unit, LaunchAgent, or Windows logon task; delete its config and script
Revoke and rotate from a clean machine
GitHub, npm, cloud, SSH and GPG, Kubernetes, Vault, .env, AI tool keys
Audit what the tokens could write to
.claude and .vscode commits, author claude, setup-formatter branch, unexpected npm versions
Any machine you cannot prove clean
